title: Barcelona from the sea
text:
Sailing …. 
We didn’t get the Segrada … but we sailed. We were lucky to be able to grab tickets for Segrada on a later date. I will say it was slightly misleading - and if you search reviews this seems to be a thing. However - what a great way to experience Barcelona! We sailed with Capitan Federico, and it was 2 hours of peace outside the city but such a great way to see the coast. The only thing we didn’t do is wear bathing suits where we could’ve swam in the sea, which would’ve been amazing! The history and scenic tour was fantastic – there was plenty of beer and cava with some light snacks
author: Amy_S
